# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y1 (Zhengdong and Xuanzheng, oe_y1_). Generated by gen_yuan_y1.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line's scheduler (global var oe_dbg_n_y1).
oe_y1_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_y1 value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_y1 add = 1 }
}

# KOR scope. Usage: oe_y1_kor_influence = { amount = N }. Moves vanilla's Mongol influence count (flavor_kor.1-.5), only
# once vanilla has set it (flavor_kor.1, from 1340).
oe_y1_kor_influence = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = kor_is_influenced_by_mongols } change_variable = { name = kor_is_influenced_by_mongols add = $amount$ } }
}

# Any scope. The first run in a new 1337 game: the line starts and the markers go on (Goryeo: Zhengdong; the Tibetan lands:
# Xuanzheng by pacification commission, country var oe_y1_xz_unit 1 Ü-Tsang, 2 Dokham, 3 Amdo).
oe_y1_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_y1_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_m value = oe_y1_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = no country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { oe_y1_sub = yes } }
        c:KOR = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong months = 13 mode = replace }
            if = { limit = { has_ruler = yes } ruler = { set_variable = oe_y1_start_king } }
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = no }
        c:TIB ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 1 } } }
        c:HOR ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 2 } } }
        c:GOL ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 2 } } }
        c:AMD ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:GYE ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:CKL ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:HEZ ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:MNZ ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:TAZ ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
        c:KHG ?= { if = { limit = { oe_y1_sub = yes } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_unit value = 3 } } }
    }
    oe_y1_xz_recount = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: the line starts (Zhengdong and Xuanzheng markers)"
}

# Any scope. Ends the Zhengdong marker, reason 1 (vanilla flavor_kor.4); the Gi clan goes with it.
oe_y1_zd_close_1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_zd_end value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_zd_end_m value = oe_y1_m_now }
    c:KOR ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_ki_clan } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_ki_clan } }
    debug_log = "oe_y1: Zhengdong marker removed (reason 1, vanilla flavor_kor.4)"
}

# Any scope (also F6's hook). The Zhengdong marker ends when vanilla flavor_kor.4 fired, the Yuan fell, Goryeo left the
# Yuan or no longer exists. Harmless when called again.
oe_y1_end_zhengdong = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:KOR } } oe_y1_zd_close_5 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { c:KOR = { dynamic_historical_event_fired = flavor_kor.4 } } oe_y1_zd_close_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes } oe_y1_zd_close_4 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { c:KOR = { oe_y1_sub = no } } oe_y1_zd_close_3 = yes }
    }
}

# Any scope. Counts the countries still under a Xuanzheng marker (global var oe_y1_xz_n); the month the last one ended
# goes to oe_y1_xz_end_m.
oe_y1_xz_recount = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n value = 0 }
    c:TIB ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:HOR ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:GOL ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:AMD ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:GYE ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:CKL ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:HEZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:MNZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:TAZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    c:KHG ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_n add = 1 } } }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y1_xz_n = 0 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_end_m } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end_m value = oe_y1_m_now }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: no Xuanzheng marker left"
    }
}

# Any scope (also F6's hook for vanilla red_turban_rebellions.44). A Xuanzheng marker ends when its country is no longer
# the Yuan's subject or the Yuan fell (country var oe_y1_xz_end: 2 after vanilla .44, else 1). Harmless when called again.
oe_y1_end_xuanzheng = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_n }
        c:TIB ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } OR = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes oe_y1_sub = no } }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang }
                if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 1 } }
                debug_log = "oe_y1: Xuanzheng marker removed from TIB"
            }
        }
        c:HOR ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } OR = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes oe_y1_sub = no } }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham }
                if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 1 } }
                debug_log = "oe_y1: Xuanzheng marker removed from HOR"
            }
        }
        c:GOL ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } OR = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes oe_y1_sub = no } }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham }
                if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 1 } }
                debug_log = "oe_y1: Xuanzheng marker removed from GOL"
            }
        }
        c:AMD ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } OR = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes oe_y1_sub = no } }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo }
                if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 1 } }
                debug_log = "oe_y1: Xuanzheng marker removed from AMD"
            }
        }
        c:GYE ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } OR = { oe_y1_yuan_fallen = yes oe_y1_sub = no } }
                if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo }
                if = { limit = { has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_y1_xz_end value = 1 } }
                debug_log = "oe_y1: Xuanzheng marker removed from GYE"
            }

# Any scope. F6's hook (gen_yuan_y3.py COLLAPSE_HOOKS): runs inside oe_yp_dissolve_all, after oe_yp_dissolved is set.
oe_y1_on_yuan_fall = {
    oe_y1_end_zhengdong = yes
    oe_y1_end_xuanzheng = yes
}

# Any scope, January. The standing markers get 13 more months (they lapse by themselves if the scheduler stops).
oe_y1_renew = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on }
        c:KOR ?= {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong months = 13 mode = replace }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_ki_empress } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_ki_clan months = 13 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
    c:TIB ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:HOR ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:GOL ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:AMD ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:GYE ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:CKL ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:HEZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:MNZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:TAZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    c:KHG ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo months = 13 mode = replace } } }
}

# Any scope. The deposed King of Goryeo (event .5) dies silently in exile (history: Yueyang, 1344.1).
oe_y1_exile_dies = {
    set_global_variable = oe_y1_exile_done
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_y1_exiled_king is_alive = yes } } }
        c:CHI = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_exiled_king is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_y1_exile_target } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_y1_exiled_king is_alive = yes } } }
        c:KOR = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_exiled_king is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_y1_exile_target } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_y1_exile_target }
        kill_character_silently = scope:oe_y1_exile_target
        debug_log = "oe_y1: the deposed King of Goryeo died in exile"
    }
}

# Any scope, monthly while the line runs. Records the moments the schedule waits for, then the marker upkeep.
oe_y1_upkeep = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_king } country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_y1_start_king } } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_king value = global_var:oe_y1_m }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: Goryeo has a new king"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_bayan } oe_y1_bayan_in_power = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_bayan value = global_var:oe_y1_m }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: Bayan no longer holds power"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_rtr } situation:red_turban_rebellions = { situation_is_active = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_rtr value = global_var:oe_y1_m }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: the Red Turban situation has begun"
    }
    oe_y1_end_zhengdong = yes
    oe_y1_end_xuanzheng = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_king_in_dadu } oe_y1_bayan_in_power = no }
        c:KOR = { remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_king_in_dadu }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: the King of Goryeo returns from Dadu"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y1_exile_pending = yes global_var:oe_y1_m >= global_var:oe_y1_exile_m }
        oe_y1_exile_dies = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_y1_renew = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scheduler (Y4 pattern; state in global vars)
oe_y1_fire_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_st1 value = oe_y1_m_now }
    oe_y1_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.1 sent to CHI"
    c:CHI ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y1.1 }
}
oe_y1_fire_2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_2 value = 1 }
    oe_y1_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.2 sent to TIB"
    c:TIB ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y1.2 }
}
oe_y1_fire_3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_3 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_st3 value = oe_y1_m_now }
    oe_y1_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.3 sent to KOR"
    c:KOR ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y1.3 }
}
oe_y1_fire_4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_4 value = 1 }
    oe_y1_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.4 sent to CHI"
    c:CHI ?= { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y1.4 }
}
oe_y1_fire_5 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_5 value = 1 }
    oe_y1_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.5 sent to CHI"

    oe_y1_count = yes

# Any scope. Drops events that can no longer fire.
oe_y1_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_1 value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_d_st1 value = global_var:oe_y1_m } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.1 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_2 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.2 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_3 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.3 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_4 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.4 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_5 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.5 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_st_6 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y1: event oe_y1.6 dropped" }
}
# Any scope. Picks at most one event this month: an event at its window end first, else one roll per open event.
oe_y1_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y1_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 6 } }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_1 = yes NOT = { oe_y1_yv_busy = yes } } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_1 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_2 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_3 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_4 = yes NOT = { oe_y1_yv_busy = yes } } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_4 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_5 = yes NOT = { oe_y1_yv_busy = yes } } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_5 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 0 oe_y1_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y1_ch_6 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_pick value = 6 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 1 } oe_y1_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 2 } oe_y1_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 3 } oe_y1_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 4 } oe_y1_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 5 } oe_y1_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 6 } oe_y1_fire_6 = yes }
}

# BYZ scope (any scope works), monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 10 "y1") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_init } }. The first call decides once
# whether this is a new 1337 game. The events take no main-line lock (they never go to Byzantium).
oe_y1_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_init } }
        set_global_variable = oe_y1_init
        if = { limit = { current_date < 1337.6.1 } oe_y1_setup = yes }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_y1: not a new 1337 game, the line stays off" }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_m value = oe_y1_m_now }
        oe_y1_upkeep = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_y1_sched_open = yes } oe_y1_ev_lapse = yes oe_y1_ev_pick = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_y1_sched_open = yes } NOT = { oe_y1_keep_running = yes } }
            remove_global_variable = oe_y1_on
            debug_log = "oe_y1: the line is over (schedule closed, no marker left)"
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- worker jobs (hidden event oe_y1.20)
# CHI scope. Event .5 option a: the king is deposed. With an heir: the heir rules, the old king goes to the Yuan court
# (character var oe_y1_exiled_king) and dies 2 months later; Goryeo's opinion of the Yuan and its stability fall.
# Without an heir: only Goryeo's legitimacy falls.
oe_y1_job_depose = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes has_heir = yes } }
        c:KOR = {
            ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_y1_old_king }
            heir = { save_scope_as = oe_y1_new_king }
            set_new_ruler = scope:oe_y1_new_king
        }
        scope:oe_y1_old_king = {
            set_variable = oe_y1_exiled_king
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } move_country = c:CHI }
        }
        c:KOR = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y1_king_deposed target = c:CHI }
            add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_exile_m value = oe_y1_m_now }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_exile_m add = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: the King of Goryeo is deposed and taken to Dadu"
    }
    else = {
        c:KOR ?= { add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_penalty }
        debug_log = "oe_y1: the King of Goryeo is rebuked (no heir to take the throne)"
    }
}
# KOR scope. Event .6 option a: the Judicial Office is abolished; the Zhengdong marker ends (reason 2); up to two Mongol
# aristocrats (vanilla flavor_kor.1/.3 characters) go back to the Yuan, as vanilla flavor_kor.3 option b sends one.
oe_y1_job_lisuo = {
    set_variable = oe_y1_lisuo_abolished
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on } oe_y1_zd_close_2 = yes }
    oe_y1_kor_influence = { amount = -3 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        random_character = { limit = { has_variable = kor_is_mongol_aristocrat } move_country = c:CHI }
        random_character = { limit = { has_variable = kor_is_mongol_aristocrat } move_country = c:CHI }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev page buttons; any scope)
# Clears every global of this line and every marker, event modifier and variable it set (not opinions, not characters).
oe_y1_test_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_init } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_on } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_king } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_d_king }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_bayan } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_d_bayan }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_rtr } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_d_rtr }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_st1 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_d_st1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_d_st3 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_d_st3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_ki_empress } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_ki_empress }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_exile_m } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_exile_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_exile_done } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_exile_done }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_end } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_end_m } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_zd_end_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_n } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_n }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_end_m } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_xz_end_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } remove_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_2 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_5 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_6 } remove_global_variable = oe_y1_st_6 }
    c:KOR ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_zhengdong } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_ki_clan } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_ki_clan } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_king_in_dadu } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_king_in_dadu } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_lisuo_abolished } remove_variable = oe_y1_lisuo_abolished } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_job } remove_variable = oe_y1_job }
        if = { limit = { has_ruler = yes } ruler = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_start_king } remove_variable = oe_y1_start_king } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_confirmed_king } remove_variable = oe_y1_confirmed_king } } }
    }
    c:TIB ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_utsang } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:HOR ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:GOL ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_dokham } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:AMD ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:GYE ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:CKL ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:HEZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:MNZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:TAZ ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:KHG ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } remove_country_modifier = oe_y1_xz_amdo } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_unit } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } remove_variable = oe_y1_xz_end } }
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_job } remove_variable = oe_y1_job } }
    c:TIB ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y1_job } remove_variable = oe_y1_job } }
}
# The line runs from now in any game: markers on again, every event pending (windows already past lapse at once).
oe_y1_test_start = {
    oe_y1_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_y1_init
    oe_y1_setup = yes
}
# One month of the line now (starts it first in a game where it never started).
oe_y1_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_init } } set_global_variable = oe_y1_init oe_y1_setup = yes }
    oe_y1_monthly = yes
}
# Sends one event now (its own trigger still applies; the console 'event oe_y1.N' ignores it).
oe_y1_test_fire_1 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_m value = oe_y1_m_now } } oe_y1_fire_1 = yes }
oe_y1_test_fire_2 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y1_m value = oe_y1_m_now } } oe_y1_fire_2 = yes }

# Switches the line off and clears it (the next scheduler round finds it initialised and leaves it off).
oe_y1_test_reset = {
    oe_y1_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_y1_init
    debug_log = "oe_y1 TEST: line reset and off"
}
